# PowerShell completion of my-app.
# Load it with: my-app completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression

Register-ArgumentCompleter -Native -CommandName 'my-app' -ScriptBlock {
    param($wordToComplete, $commandAst, $cursorPosition)
    $words = @($commandAst.CommandElements |
        Where-Object { $_.Extent.EndOffset -lt $cursorPosition } |
        ForEach-Object { $_.Extent.Text })
    $current = "$wordToComplete"
    if ($current -eq '' -and ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion -lt [version]'7.3' -or $PSNativeCommandArgumentPassing -eq 'Legacy')) {
        $current = '""'
    }
    $arguments = @($words | Select-Object -Skip 1) + $current
    $lines = @(& $words[0] completion powershell -- @arguments 2>$null)
    if ($lines.Count -eq 0) {
        return
    }
    if ($lines[-1] -like ':files*') {
        if ("$wordToComplete" -notmatch '^(-[^=]*=)(.*)$') {
            return
        }
        $prefix, $path = $Matches[1], $Matches[2]
        $exts = @(($lines[-1] -replace '^:files ?', '') -split ' ' | Where-Object { $_ })
        $parent = Split-Path -Path $path -Parent
        foreach ($item in @(Get-ChildItem -Path "$path*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
            if (-not $item.PSIsContainer -and $exts.Count -gt 0 -and $exts -notcontains $item.Extension.TrimStart('.')) {
                continue
            }
            $name = if ($parent) { Join-Path -Path $parent -ChildPath $item.Name } else { $item.Name }
            if ($item.PSIsContainer) {
                $name += [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar
            }
            [System.Management.Automation.CompletionResult]::new("$prefix$name", $name, 'ProviderItem', $name)
        }
        return
    }
    foreach ($line in @($lines | Select-Object -SkipLast 1)) {
        $value, $text = $line -split "`t", 2
        if (-not $text) {
            $text = $value
        }
        [System.Management.Automation.CompletionResult]::new($value, $value, 'ParameterValue', $text)
    }
}
